title: Data Analyst I - AMS
description:
Extracts knowledge and insights from high volume, high dimensional data in order to investigate complex business problems through a range of data preparation, modeling, analysis and/or visualization techniques, which may include the use of advanced statistical analysis, algorithms, predictive modeling, experimentation and pattern recognition to create solutions that enable enhanced business performance. Examines and identifies data patterns and trends to help answer business questions and improve decision making. Provides inputs for complex Data Science and Big Data Mining projects. Identifies areas to increase efficiency and automation of data analysis processes.
Nordson seeks an experienced data analyst with expertise in Power BI, MS Azure and Denodo. In your role as a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for Customer Requirements, Troubleshooting, Power BI Development, and Testing across functional teams and across multiple Nordson Business units. Your responsibilities include software development, customer interfacing, data analysis, and Denodo configuration with data initiatives and ensuring a consistent data delivery is put in place throughout ongoing projects.


**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Design and implement corporate Power BI solutions interfacing with Azure services such as Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse and Azure Data Lake Storage
* Develop and maintain Service Now data to enact DnA solutions
* Understand and help maintain corporate Denodo architecture
* Create and maintain Denodo metadata
* Understand business objectives, define performance metrics and drive data\-driven strategies to achieve them.
* Work cross\-functionally to support multiple key stakeholders and provide insights
* Work with the DnA Team and Business users to create Business Intelligence visualizations
* Evaluate ServiceNow issues to identify and recommend solutions to strategic DnA issues
* Perform complex data analysis, identify the root cause of system and process issues, and develop solutions
* Assess the end\-to\-end process and identify opportunities for enhancement; develop dashboards and report insights
* Define objectives per business requirements; assist business analysts, data analysts, and data scientists in analyzing the data

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Experience in large\-scale datasets, analysing data to solve business problems, and presenting impactful insights to all levels of a corporate hierarchy
* Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL tools used in data modelling and data mining processes
* Experience in data warehousing and understanding of data extraction techniques like ETL processing
* Ability to collaborate with multiple business partners and thrive in a fast\-paced environment
* Interpret insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
* Technical leadership to mentor other analysts to ensure best practices.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics or similar field

**Preferred Skills and Abilities**

* Experience in data analysis and developing technological business strategies
* Knowledge of SQL and cloud data warehousing technologies, including Denodo
* Strong analytical mindset and creative problem\-solving skills
* Experience in using BI and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI and Looker
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

title: Product Analyst, Tech Platform & Data
description:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.



Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state\-of\-the\-art open\- and closed\-source AI models with our human\-in\-the\-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.



Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world’s most innovative lenders do business.


We are looking for a detail\-oriented and technically sharp Product Analyst to support the strategy and execution of our core technical platform and data infrastructure products. You will serve as the analytical backbone of the team translating data into insights, tracking platform health, and enabling better product decisions through rigorous measurement and documentation.



This is an excellent role for someone who is passionate about data, platform operations, and product craft, and who wants to grow into a senior product or data role in a fast\-paced fintech environment.


### **What you will be doing:**


#### **Analytics \& Insights:**


* Own the collection, analysis, and reporting of key platform metrics including system uptime, API latency, developer deployment frequency, and data quality scores.
* Build and maintain dashboards to track platform health and adoption trends across internal consumers.
* Proactively surface anomalies, regressions, or usage trends and translate them into clear product recommendations.

#### **Product Support \& Documentation:**


* Support the PM in writing and maintaining PRDs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Conduct research and competitive analysis to inform roadmap decisions.
* Document findings from stakeholder interviews, incident reviews, and backlog grooming sessions.

#### **Stakeholder Research:**


* Gather and synthesize feedback from internal platform consumers such as application developers, data analysts, and other PMs to identify friction points and unmet needs.
* Assist in running lightweight discovery sessions and translating qualitative feedback into structured problem statements.

#### **Data \& Platform Operations:**


* Monitor data pipeline health and flag issues across ingestion, transformation, and delivery layers.
* Work with Engineering and Data teams to validate data quality and ensure accuracy of reported metrics.

#### **Execution Support:**


* Track sprint progress, manage the product backlog under PM direction, and flag risks or blockers.
* Assist in preparing materials for roadmap reviews, quarterly business reviews, and executive presentations.
* Help coordinate dependency management across platform and application teams.

### **What you'll bring:**


* **2–4 years** of experience in a product analyst, data analyst, business analyst, or associate PM role, ideally in a technical or platform product environment.
* **Strong SQL proficiency** comfortable writing complex queries against data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar) to answer product questions independently.
* **Working knowledge of data infrastructure** concepts: data pipelines, APIs, data warehousing, and BI tools (Tableau, Metabase, etc.).
* **Familiarity with cloud and microservices environments** (AWS/GCP/Azure, REST APIs, containerization concepts) \- you don't need to write infrastructure code, but you should be able to read architecture docs and ask the right questions.
* **Clear written communication** \- able to translate technical findings into crisp summaries for both engineers and business stakeholders.
* **Experience with project/product tools** such as Jira, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related analytical field or equivalent hands\-on experience.

### **Nice to Have:**


* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, dbt, or Airflow.
* Experience in a fintech or enterprise SaaS environment.
* Familiarity with internal developer platforms (IDPs) or platform engineering concepts.
* Prior experience supporting a senior PM or working in an embedded analytics function.

### **What a Typical Day Might Look Like:**


* Pulling platform usage data from Snowflake to answer a question raised during the weekly metrics review.
* Updating the team's health dashboard after a data pipeline regression was flagged overnight.
* Drafting user stories for an upcoming sprint with acceptance criteria reviewed by the PM.
* Interviewing two internal engineering teams to document their pain points with the current data ingestion workflow.
* Preparing slide content for the PM's quarterly roadmap presentation to leadership.
**Life at Ocrolus**



We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast\-growing, remote\-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.


**Our culture is grounded in four core values:**  

**Empathy –** Understand and serve with compassion  

**Curiosity –** Explore new ideas and question the status quo  

**Humility –** Listen, be grounded, and remain open\-minded  

**Ownership –** Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence



We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.



We look forward to building the future of lending together.

title: Pre-Sales Research Analyst
description:
**Key Responsibilities Lead Research \& Prospecting**

* Research and identify potential clients based on target market criteria.
* Build and maintain prospect databases using LinkedIn, company websites, industry directories, and online databases.
* Verify contact information including decision\-makers, emails, phone numbers, and company details.
* Segment prospects based on industry, company size, geography, and business needs.

**Sales Intelligence \& Market Research**

* Conduct company profiling and competitive analysis.
* Research industry trends, market opportunities, and customer pain points.
* Identify triggers such as funding announcements, expansions, leadership changes, or acquisitions that create sales opportunities.
* Prepare prospect briefs for the sales team before outreach.

**Appointment Setting Support**

* Develop targeted prospect lists for appointment setters.
* Assist in creating personalized outreach strategies.
* Track prospect engagement and update CRM systems.
* Support follow\-up campaigns and nurture activities.

**CRM \& Data Management**

* Maintain accurate records in CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, etc.).
* Ensure lead data quality and completeness.
* Generate reports on lead generation activities and campaign performance.

**Collaboration**

* Work closely with sales, marketing, and business development teams.
* Participate in sales strategy discussions and campaign planning.
* Provide feedback on lead quality and market opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (preferred).
* 1\-3 years of experience in lead generation, sales research, appointment setting, or business development support.
* Strong internet research and data analysis skills.
* Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with CRM systems such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Preferred Skills**

* B2B sales and prospecting experience min 1 year.
* Knowledge of healthcare, technology, SaaS, or senior care industries.
* Experience with email outreach tools and marketing automation platforms.
* Understanding of sales funnels and lead qualification frameworks
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of qualified leads generated per month.
* Accuracy of prospect data.
* Number of appointments booked from researched leads.
* Lead\-to\-appointment conversion rate.
* CRM data quality score.
* Sales team satisfaction with lead quality.

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in a Pre\-Sales Research profile? Please describe your experience.
* How many years of experience do you have in B2B Sales?
* Do you have experience with CRM systems? If yes, which ones have you used?
* Examples: Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive
* How would you rate your English communication skills (written and verbal) on a scale of 1–10?
* What is your current CTC (Cost to Company)?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your notice period, or how soon can you join?
* What tools have you used for prospect research?
* Examples: LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo.io, ZoomInfo
* Have you worked with international clients or markets?

Work Location: Remote

title: Investment Analyst (Fund Selection, Manager Research & Due Diligence)
description:
**About FundFinity**

FundFinity is VaR's specialist third\-party marketing (TPM) firm bringing best\-in\-class international asset managers to institutional and wholesale investors, across both liquid (open\-ended: credit, EM, equities, fixed income) and illiquid strategies (closed\-end / private markets: infrastructure debt, CLOs, real assets, alternatives). Small, senior, AI\-enabled team — not a KPO.

**The Role**

As Investment Analyst (independent contractor), you own the analytical work at the core of our business: screening and researching asset managers, running our AI\-assisted fund triage, driving due diligence, and authoring the research and proposals that win mandates. Across both liquid and illiquid strategies. Human\-in\-the\-loop: our AI agents handle throughput; you provide the judgement, quality control and final word.

**What you'll do**

* Asset manager research
* AI\-assisted fund triage
* Deep\-dive investment research
* Drive the DDQ process and analyse data\-room material with AI
* Author client\-facing proposals in flawless English

**Must\-haves**

* 3–5 years in buy\-side support, manager research, ODD/IDD, or investment research
* Genuine exposure across both liquid and illiquid strategies
* Strong financial modelling
* Exceptional written English
* High AI fluency
* Self\-directed

**This is not for you if**

* You're a pure sell\-side equity analyst with no liquid/illiquid breadth
* You're primarily a salesperson
* You need detailed supervision

**Nice\-to\-haves**

* Experience supporting international clients (manager\-research firm, KPO, wealth manager)
* Hands\-on alternatives / private\-market exposure
* German a bonus

**Ideal qualifications**

* CFA (L3 candidate or charterholder) preferred, a plus rather than a hard requirement depending on fit
* CAIA a plus
* FRM/MBA welcome
* Demonstrated output and writing quality outweigh certificates

**What we offer**

* Varied senior work across liquid and illiquid strategies
* Direct founder relationship and real ownership
* A front\-row seat building an AI\-augmented research engine
* Remote flexibility

**Please note:** This role is offered on an independent contractor basis.

**How to apply**

Send the following to jobs(at)valueresearch.io

(1\) CV

(2\) a short note (max 200\-300 words) on the most interesting fund or manager you've researched, and why

(3\) one writing sample you authored (redacted fine).

Shortlisted candidates complete a short work task and interviews before any offer.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Please briefly describe your experience in investment research, manager research, fund selection, due diligence (IDD/ODD), and DDQ work. Include years of experience in each area where applicable.
* Please briefly describe your experience producing investment\-related written materials in English (if any).
* What is your expected annual compensation?
